ruleset.name: NUSynapxe Test Rules
ruleset.description:
PMD rules for JUnit, Mockito, persistence-fixture, service, and TestFX tests. Error-prone checks remain enabled. The selected best-practice checks focus on resource safety, unused code, and maintainable loops.
JUnit tests may omit assertion messages when the assertion and test name already explain the failure, and Mockito stubbing and verification are intentionally left to the Mockito/JUnit checks. Persistence tests use repeated database and domain literals as readable fixtures. TestFX classes own the ApplicationTest lifecycle, so their start methods do not call an inherited implementation.
